inputs.text:
Cinematic 3D render, photorealistic, sci-fi action scene.

Subject and action: a masked superhero in a form-fitting red-and-blue tactical suit,
slim white spider-eye lenses on the mask, black webbing pattern across the fabric,
lunging forward in a low crouch, right fist mid-swing, left hand firing a strand of
glowing synthetic webbing. Opposite him, a female spider demon mid-transformation:
beautiful humanoid upper body with porcelain-pale skin, elaborate black-and-gold
ornamental armor, six long chitinous spider legs erupting from her back, each leg
tipped with a metallic joint, her hands trailing hundreds of razor-thin silk threads
that fan out like fiber-optic cables.

Environment: a vast underground cavern fused with a derelict sci-fi facility —
carved stone walls veined with pulsing cyan energy conduits, hanging cocoons of
translucent silk glowing faintly from within, broken server racks and rusted
industrial pipes on the wet floor, shallow water reflecting neon light.

Camera: 35mm anamorphic lens, low angle slightly below chest height, medium-wide
shot, shallow depth of field, subject sharp in the foreground, cavern receding into
atmospheric haze.

Lighting: hard cyan rim light from the left conduit wall, warm amber practical spill
from a broken ceiling lamp, cool magenta bounce off the water, high contrast,
volumetric god rays through dust and silk fibers.

Material and render: physically based shading, subsurface scattering on skin,
anisotropic sheen on the suit fabric, subsurface glow on the silk threads,
micro-detail on the chitin legs, subtle motion blur on the swinging arm,
ray-traced reflections, 8K detail, Unreal Engine 5 cinematic quality, film grain,
color-graded like a modern blockbuster.

Constraints: anatomically correct hands, exactly six spider legs, clean readable
silhouettes, no text, no watermark, no extra limbs.
